SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: --LINKAPPMENUHIDE --LINKDETAILLIST(TMESPUR06,20,{0}) --LINKMYROWDATA SELECT S.[ID] LINKROWID ,S.[DOCNUM] ,S.[DOCNUM] id ,S.[DOCGRP] ,DOCGRP.OPTDES DOCGRPDES ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTA ,WFLSTA.OPTDES WFLSTA ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.[DOCDAT], 21) [DOCDAT] ,S.[DOCDES] ,S.[PRJNUM] ,S.[SITE] ,SI.[SITENAM] SITEDES ,S.FAC ,F.FACNAM ,S.[DEPT] ,D.DEPTNAM DEPTDES ,S.[GRP] ,G.GRPNAM GRPDES ,S.[RESNO] ,R.RESNAM RESNODES ,S.[REMARK] ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,CASE WHEN S.UPDTIM IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) END UPDTIM ,S.[CLOREA] ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') SABFLG ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') DEBFLG ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') SUBFLG ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA] = '3' AND S.[UPDUSR] = '#LOGIN_USER#', '', '1') REBFLG ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA]='2', '', '1') CLBFLG ,Iif(S.[DOCSTA] = '4', '', '1') PRTFLG ,'{1}' SIGNLISTID ,'{2}' TASKID ,'TSICOD1' FLDTS1S --勿删，产品统计组1传参 ,'TSICOD2' FLDTS2S --勿删，产品统计组2传参 ,'TSICOD3' FLDTS3S --勿删，产品统计组3传参 ,'TSICOD4' FLDTS4S --勿删，产品统计组4传参 ,'' TCLCODL ,'' TSICOD1L ,'' TSICOD2L --这几个空值字段，用于选择跳框的参数，不可删除 ,'' TSICOD3L ,'' TSICOD4L ,'' ITMNOL ,'' ITMSIZEL ,'' ITMSPECL ,'' ITML --,N'' PPREQAH FROM [dbo].[PREQAH] S LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT WFLSTA ON WFLSTA.OPTID = S.WFLSTA AND WFLSTA.OPTTYP = 'WFLSTA' LEFT JOIN [ENTSITE] SI ON S.[SITE] = SI.SITE LEFT JOIN ENTFAC F ON S.FAC = F.FAC LEFT JOIN [LINKOPT] DOCGRP ON S.DOCGRP = DOCGRP.OPTID AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'PRA' LEFT JOIN [ENTDEPT] D ON S.[DEPT] = D.DEPT LEFT JOIN [ENTGRP] G ON S.[GRP] = G.GRP LEFT JOIN [ENTRES] R ON S.[RESNO] = R.RESNO WHERE S. [DOCNUM] = '{0}' UNION ALL SELECT '' LINKROWID ,N'#LINKDOCNUM({0},PRA)#' [DOCNUM] ,N'#LINKDOCNUM({0},PRA)#' id ,'' [DOCGRP] ,'' [DOCGRPDES] ,'' [DOCSTA] ,'' [WFLSTA] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Getdate(), 21) [DOCDAT] ,'' [DOCDES] ,'' [PRJNUM] ,N'#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DEPT1#' [SITE] ,N'#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DEPT1#' [SITEDES] ,'' FAC ,'' FACNAM ,N'#LINKUSER(#LOGIN_USER#).DEPT3#' [DEPT] ,'' [DEPTDES] ,'' [GRP] ,'' [GRPDES] ,'' [RESNO] ,'' [RESNODES] ,'' [REMARK] ,'' [CREUSR] ,'' [UPDUSR] ,'' CRETIM ,'' UPDTIM ,'' [CLOREA] ,'' SABFLG ,'1' DEBFLG ,'1' SUBFLG ,'1' REBFLG ,'1' CLBFLG ,'1' PRTFLG ,'{1}' SIGNLISTID ,'{2}' TASKID ,'TSICOD1' FLDTS1S --勿删，产品统计组1传参 ,'TSICOD2' FLDTS2S --勿删，产品统计组2传参 ,'TSICOD3' FLDTS3S --勿删，产品统计组3传参 ,'TSICOD4' FLDTS4S --勿删，产品统计组4传参 ,'' TCLCODL ,'' TSICOD1L ,'' TSICOD2L --这几个空值字段，用于选择跳框的参数，不可删除 ,'' TSICOD3L ,'' TSICOD4L ,'' ITMNOL ,'' ITMSIZEL ,'' ITMSPECL ,'' ITML --, N'' PPREQAH WHERE '' = '{0}'
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS MERGE INTO [PREQAH] D USING ( SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'SAVED' WFLSTA ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@FAC@' FAC ,N'@DEPT@' DEPT ,N'@GRP@' GRP ,N'@RESNO@' RESNO ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA , N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM ,DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP ,DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT ,DOCDES = S.DOCDES ,PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM ,SITE = S.SITE ,FAC = S.FAC ,DEPT = S.DEPT ,GRP = S.GRP ,RESNO = S.RESNO ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,CLOREA = S.CLOREA ,UPDUSR='#LOGIN_USER#' ,UPDTIM=GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM ,DOCGRP ,DOCSTA ,WFLSTA ,DOCDAT ,DOCDES ,PRJNUM ,SITE ,FAC ,DEPT ,GRP ,RESNO ,REMARK ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCGRP ,S.DOCSTA ,S.WFLSTA ,S.DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,S.SITE ,S.FAC ,S.DEPT ,S.GRP ,S.RESNO ,S.REMARK ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM );
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM PREQAH WHERE DOCNUM='#DOCNUM#' AND DOCSTA='1';
